review_locator: PMCID:PMC6299044, Epigenetic and Transcriptional Regulation in the Induction, Maintenance, Heterogeneity, and Recall-Response of Effector and Memory Th2 Cells
primary_title: STAT6-mediated displacement of polycomb by trithorax complex establishes long-term maintenance of GATA3 expression in T helper type 2 cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows rapid STAT6 accumulation at regulatory regions of the GATA3 locus after IL-4 stimulation and IL-4/STAT6-dependent GATA3 transcription in Th2 cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-4-associated GATA3 gene-expression bridge alongside the existing IL4 receptor-complex-to-STAT6 edge; preserve Th2/STAT6 chromatin context and do not treat GATA3 as a terminal target gene.
